name: Ikeda Shinnosuke
source: The protagonist of the Genroku period. A mild-mannered young man born into a fallen samurai family. Though he attends the Akiba Itto-ryu dojo and is a skilled swordsman, his true heart's desire is to make a living as an artist.
translation: The protagonist of the Genroku period. A mild-mannered young man born into a fallen samurai family. Though he attends the Akiba Itto-ryu dojo and is a skilled swordsman, his true heart's desire is to make a living as an artist.
